role: Exact unresolved-singleton and pair-correlation prerequisite after the all-candidate one-site structural screen
question: At the same complete first public record, does any of the twelve frozen private physical-error alternatives change a second-charge singleton or pair parity moment relative to the base under either frozen public action?
source_basis: J7X covers all twelve same-first errors and both actions but leaves some one-site means unresolved and every joint moment untested
J7T fixes all twelve candidate supports and their exact first masses
J7M fixes the base complete second law and its one/five variable sites
J7W fixes two complete-law null peer controls
frozen_model: The same J7X ideal periodic L=2 D4 ground orbit, pre-existing 36-red-edge physical red-X errors, selected complete first binary public flux/charge/vacuum record, and two relation-free public actions. No new error, geometry, rate, online information, observation channel or loss score.

matrix.design: All twelve candidates and a base control under both actions. Evaluate the exact selected-first expectation of every singleton among the one or five non-deterministic-or-unresolved second sites and all ten pairs among the five loop-action sites. The 21/17 remaining sites are already resolved deterministic plus by J7X.
matrix.method:
Let P be the product of commuting selected-first + projectors and B the commuting product of selected second-star operators. If B anticommutes with any first projector, PBP=0 and the parity mean is zero. Otherwise /

=sum_S /sum_S , where S ranges over subsets of first-variable stars; each orbit moment is exact integer algebra. Reconstruct no complete second law in this tick.
matrix.comparison_rule: Any exact singleton or pair parity mean different from the base under the same action/sites proves a different complete second public law. Equality at orders one and two does not imply equality of three-to-five-site correlations or full-IID information.
matrix.integrity: Pins before and after; exact first mass equals each J7T row, all matched complete first/second flux and eligible sites, commuting first/second projectors, J7X resolved one-site labels, exact zero singleton/pair means for the base and both J7W complete-law null peers. Fail closed on any mismatch.
matrix.uncertainty: Finite exact rational parity moments conditional on one positive first record; no sampling or interval. The design has no full-channel or logical-risk estimand.

acceptance: All twelve candidate-by-two-action cells plus two base controls and their 1/15 moments are complete
Every first mass and public flux matches frozen provenance; exact base and peer controls agree with J7M/J7W
Any positive result is called a low-order complete-law difference witness only; a null preserves higher-order and other-geometry possibilities
No histories, arms, bootstraps, full law, full-IID information, logical loss or threshold fitting

outcomes.positive_witness: Register separately bounded complete-law and restricted-pair information work for all affordable positive candidates/actions, without post hoc favorable selection.
outcomes.all_low_order_null: Retain higher-order joint-correlation and other-geometry possibilities; the next transition may test all remaining order-three-to-five moments under a separate budget.
outcomes.censored: Pin, mass, flux, algebra, control, budget or runtime failure releases no moment comparison.

stop_rule: Stop after the 26 fixed cells and their registered singleton/pair moments or earlier on any gate failure; no higher-order moment, complete law or stochastic work in this tick.
